Payment and license delivery

  1. 1. Review your order

    Paid plans renew every year until cancelled. Prices are in USD, before applicable tax. Polar shows your total and renewal terms before you pay.

  2. 2. Pay securely on Polar

    Enter your billing and payment details on Polar. Keep your confirmation email for your receipt and access to your billing portal.

  3. 3. Receive your license

    Contact us to confirm availability and delivery details before purchasing a license.

Questions about your purchase?

Do I need a ZenGrid account?

No. Use your email at checkout. You can manage invoices, payment methods, and cancellations through your Polar billing portal.

Where is my license key?

License delivery is separate from payment confirmation. We verify paid orders before issuing a signed ZenGrid license key. For delivery status or setup help, email hello@zengrid.dev from the address on your order.

My payment failed or I closed checkout. What now?

Check your email and billing portal for an existing order before trying again. If a charge is pending or its status is unclear, contact us before making another payment.

How do I cancel or request a refund?

Cancel future renewals in your billing portal. For a refund, email us from the address on your order. See the 14-day refund policy.

Payment details are entered only on Polar. 14-day refund policy. By purchasing you agree to the License Agreement and Terms. See our Refund policy and Privacy policy.
